headlines.title: PayPal’s AI Checkout Push and Agentic Commerce Vision Might Change The Case For Investing In PYPL
headlines.summary: In recent months, PayPal Holdings reported that its long-sluggish core checkout business has begun to stabilize, while it cuts costs, upgrades its technology stack, and channels resources into Venmo, Braintree, financial services and new AI-driven capabilities. The company is also building infrastructure for “agentic commerce,” where AI assistants complete purchases for users, potentially reshaping how its payments platform is used across the internet.

headlines.title: Former PayPal CEO bets on AI-powered financial planning
headlines.summary: Evergreen.ai Founder and CEO & Former Paypal CEO joins Market Domination Overtime to discuss his new venture and to discuss how artificial intelligence financial planning will deliver more personalized guidance to helping investors make smarter decisions about their money.

headlines.title: PayPal (PYPL) Has Fallen From Grace. Could AI Commerce Be Its Way Back?
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:PYPL) is a strange company to look at today. A decade ago, PayPal was one of the defining names in digital payments. It helped make online checkout mainstream and built a network of hundreds of millions of consumers and millions of merchants.

headlines.title: Affirm Climbs 5% as Buy Now Pay Later Group Rallies Together; Klarna Rises 5%, PayPal Ticks Up
headlines.summary: Buy now pay later stocks are surging together, but Klarna's brutal year-to-date losses and PayPal's smaller gain raise a pointed question about whether this is a genuine sector re-rating or just a short-lived relief bounce in the hardest-hit names.

headlines.title: Peter Thiel Was an Early Outside Investor in Facebook and Co-Founded Both PayPal and Palantir Before Building a Hedge Fund Now Concentrated in Power and Energy Stocks. Here's What That Track Record Says About Following His Contrarian Bets.
headlines.summary: Peter Thiel has scored some big wins as a tech investor and company founder, but that doesn't mean everything he touches will turn to gold.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
